name: Nutrisize
subtitle: Nutrition & Exercise Guide
shortDescription: Free with ads. Remove ads anytime with the one-time Remove Ads purchase.
longDescription:
Nutrisize is a privacy-first health intelligence app for nutrition, exercise, and human physiology.

### Nutrition
• Macro & micro nutrient guidance with daily reference intakes
  • Individualized weekly meal plans (Vegan, Vegetarian, Non-Vegetarian)
  • Per-food nutrient contribution with %DV progress bars
  • Regional nutrition guidance for global food contexts

### Exercise
• 5 intensity levels from minimal movement to military readiness
  • Age-specific plans (3-5, 6-17, 18-64, 65+) per WHO/ACSM guidelines
  • Individualized weekly exercise plans based on your health profile

HUMAN PHYSIOLOGY (Premium)
  • 201+ health parameters with normal ranges and clinical context
  • Visual range bars, Simply Put + Clinical explanations
  • Citations from WHO, CDC, AHA, NEJM, ACSM, and more
  • One-time purchase — no subscription

### My Health
• Enter and track basic health parameters (age, weight, vitals)
  • View history and trends over time
  • MDConnect — physician communication tools
whatsNew: Ads now appear in the free parts of the app. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns them off (Restore Purchases is in Settings). Bug fixes and improvements.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
